The "Copy" list still names src/modules/spaces/routes/entities/address-book-request.dto.entity.ts, but that file has moved to src/modules/spaces/routes/address-books/entities/address-book-request.dto.entity.ts, so the documentation no longer matches the actual file layout.

The glob src/modules/spaces/routes/*service.ts now only matches spaces.service.ts because the other route services moved into routes/{address-books,audit,members,safes}/, making the documented glob misleading.
The guide still calls src/modules/spaces the large product-module example to copy without describing its new per-subdomain shape, so it no longer accurately represents the module's structure.
The guide states that feature DB entities live under datasources/entities/, but spaces now uses datasources/<subdomain>/entities/, so the documented placement rule is out of date for this module.

The core Space DB entity was placed in a spaces/ subfolder under datasources/, while the corresponding core files in domain/ (domain/spaces.repository.ts, domain/entities/space.entity.ts) and routes/ (routes/spaces.controller.ts) remain at the layer root, creating an inconsistent subdomain layout across layers; either the core entity should stay at the root of datasources/ or the spaces/ subfolder should be added consistently in all three layers.
